children.text: sthānaṃ praveśo rūpaṃ ca lakṣaṃ lakṣaṇameva ca /
children.translated_text: The location (<s>sthāna</s>), the entry (<s>praveśa</s>), the form (<s>rūpa</s>), the aim (<s>lakṣa</s>), the characteristic (<s>lakṣaṇa</s>),

children.text: utthāpanaṃ bodhanaṃ ca cakraviśrāmameva ca // SomSv_1
children.translated_text: the raising (<s>utthāpana</s>), the awakening (<s>bodhana</s>), and the resting in the <s>cakras</s> (<s>cakraviśrāma</s>),
the attaining of the stages (<s>bhūmikāgamana</s>), and likewise the final state (<s>antāvasthā</s>),
the repose (<s>viśrāma</s>), the transformation (<s>pariṇāma</s>), and likewise the arrival (<s>āgamana</s>) —
thus the supreme knowledge of <s>Śakti</s> (<s>śāktavijñāna</s>) is of thirteen kinds,

children.text: sarveṣu trikaśāstreṣu sūcitaṃ śambhunā svayam // SomSv_3
children.translated_text: indicated by <s>Śambhu</s> (Śiva) himself in all the <s>Trika</s> scriptures.
Five fingers below the navel, two fingers above the generative organ —

children.text: tanmadhye kandanāmā ca cakrasthānamiti smṛtam // SomSv_4
children.translated_text: in the middle of that is the [bulb] called <s>kanda</s> (root-bulb); this is known as the location of the <s>cakra</s>.
By the restraint of <s>prāṇa</s> (inbreath) and <s>apāna</s> (outbreath), one should cast the mind right there;

children.text: samyag vāyugatiṃ jitvā yāvan madhyagatāṃ nayet // SomSv_5
children.translated_text: having properly conquered the movement of the breath, one should lead it until it enters the middle [channel].

children.text: eṣa praveśa ity āhū rūpaṃ vakṣyāmi cādhunā /
children.translated_text: This they call the 'entry' (<s>praveśa</s>). Now I shall describe the 'form' (<s>rūpa</s>):

children.text: śṛṅgāṭakanibhaṃ cakraṃ ṣaḍaraṃ cāparaṃ dhruvam // SomSv_6
children.translated_text: the <s>cakra</s> resembles a crossroads (<s>śṛṅgāṭaka</s>), and has six spokes — this is the other, the fixed [cakra].
Resembling a pomegranate flower, the <s>kanda</s> (root-bulb) is indeed naturally red —
this form has been described; the third [topic] is of the nature of contemplation (<s>cintanātmaka</s>).

children.text: tanmadhye nikṣipec cittaṃ yāvat tatra sthirīkṛtam /
children.translated_text: One should place the mind in its center until it is made steady there;

children.text: tyaktaruddho yadā vāyustadā lakṣaṃ vinirdiśet // SomSv_8
children.translated_text: when the breath, freed from restraint, [flows freely], then one should point out the aim (<s>lakṣa</s>).
Abiding in the center of the <s>kanda-cakra</s> is the <s>kalā</s> (energy) made of the unstruck [sound] (<s>anāhata</s>),
connected with lines below and above, having a serpentine coiled form.
Established in both lower and upper positions are the two — <s>Sūrya</s> (Sun) and <s>Candramā</s> (Moon);
truly resplendent, she has a radiance equal to a thousand suns.
One should gaze upon that very <s>Śakti</s> with a gentle practice of <s>kumbhaka</s> (breath-retention) —

children.text: etal lakṣaṇam uddiṣṭam utthāpanam ataḥ param // SomSv_11
children.translated_text: this has been declared as the 'characteristic' (<s>lakṣaṇa</s>). Next is the 'raising' (<s>utthāpana</s>).
Through the practice of exhaling (<s>recaka</s>) with the seed-syllable, one should utter the <s>mantra</s>;
one should contemplate the awakened <s>Śakti</s>, standing straight like a staff, the Supreme Goddess (<s>Parameśvarī</s>),
having come from the center of the base (<s>ādhāra</s>), taking the path of the <s>Suṣumnā</s> —
this has been declared as 'raising' (<s>utthāpana</s>). Similarly, after that comes 'awakening' (<s>bodhana</s>).

children.text: kandastho vedhayen nābhiṃ tato hṛtsthaṃ pitāmaham /
children.translated_text: Stationed in the <s>kanda</s>, she pierces the navel; then [she pierces] <s>Pitāmaha</s> (Brahmā), stationed in the heart;
<s>Acyuta</s> (Viṣṇu) stationed in the throat; directly, <s>Rudra</s> stationed at the palate;
<s>Īśa</s> (the Lord) situated between the eyebrows; <s>Sadāśiva</s> at the <s>Brahmadvāra</s> (door of Brahmā [at the crown]) —

children.text: bodhayitvā vrajed āśu padaṃ cānāśritaṃ śivam // SomSv_15
children.translated_text: having awakened [these], she quickly proceeds to the unattached (<s>anāśrita</s>) abode of <s>Śiva</s>.
This has been declared as 'awakening' (<s>bodhana</s>). Then comes the 'resting in the <s>cakras</s>' (<s>cakraviśrāmaṇa</s>).

children.text: svābhāvikaṃ dalaṃ dīptaṃ dravaṃ sthiranabhopamam // SomSv_16
children.translated_text: Natural, radiant, fluid, stable, sky-like,

children.text: amṛtaṃ śekharaṃ caiva śaktirbrahmā tathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>amṛta</s> (nectar), <s>śekhara</s> (crest), and <s>śakti</s>, <s>Brahmā</s> likewise,

children.text: bindunādaṃ tathā proktaṃ cakradvādaśakaṃ kila // SomSv_17
children.translated_text: <s>bindu</s> (point) and <s>nāda</s> (sound) — thus are proclaimed the twelve <s>cakras</s>.
<s>Śakti</s>, piercing successively in each <s>cakra</s>, moment by moment,

children.text: viśramet sā mahādevī cakraviśrāma uttamaḥ // SomSv_18
children.translated_text: the Great Goddess (<s>Mahādevī</s>) rests — that is the supreme 'resting in the <s>cakras</s>' (<s>cakraviśrāma</s>).
First the heart trembles, and also the door of the palate;
and the head of that [practitioner] whirls — this is the characteristic of the transference of vision (<s>dṛṣṭisaṃkrānti</s>).
Each and every limb is made to whirl, in the joints of limbs and sub-limbs;
and the heart of that [practitioner] churns — through the power of the true <s>vidyā</s> (knowledge).

children.text: yāni yāni vikārāṇi avasthā kurute sataḥ /
children.translated_text: Whatever transformations the state produces in one who exists,

children.text: teṣu teṣu na bhetavyaṃ krīḍati parameśvarī // SomSv_21
children.translated_text: in none of those should one be afraid — [for] the Supreme Goddess (<s>Parameśvarī</s>) is at play.

children.text: amṛte seyam unmattā vikārān kurute bahūn /
children.translated_text: Intoxicated by the <s>amṛta</s> (nectar), she produces many transformations;
the transformations of the three impurities (<s>malatrayavikāra</s>), whatever was done across many births —
she shakes off the impure bonds (<s>pāśa</s>) arisen from the Supreme <s>Śakti</s>.
This is called 'attaining the stages' (<s>bhūmikāgamana</s>); and the 'final state' (<s>antāvasthā</s>) is stated thus:

children.text: yat saṃkrāntau romaharṣo 'srupāto jṛmbhārambho gadgadā gīr giro 'ntaḥ /
children.translated_text: When in the transference [of consciousness], there is horripilation (<s>romaharṣa</s>), shedding of tears, onset of yawning, faltering of speech, [cessation of] inner voice,

children.text: granthisphoṭaḥ sparśadivyapraharṣo binduspandā nābhikandāt sphuranti // SomSv_24
children.translated_text: bursting of knots (<s>granthisphoṭa</s>), divine delight at touch, throbbing of the <s>bindu</s> (drop) — these pulse forth from the <s>kanda</s> at the navel.
The 'final state' (<s>antāvasthā</s>) has been described. Now the 'repose' (<s>viśrāma</s>) is stated:
when the <s>Śakti</s>, having emerged from the navel-<s>cakra</s>, is awakened,

children.text: tadā tv astamitaṃ sarvamakṣagrāmaṃ bahiḥ sthitam /
children.translated_text: then all the aggregate of senses (<s>akṣagrāma</s>), standing externally, is extinguished;

children.text: yadā sā paramā śaktiḥ sulīnā parame pade // SomSv_26
children.translated_text: when that Supreme <s>Śakti</s> is well-dissolved in the Supreme State (<s>parama pada</s>),

children.text: tadā na vindate kiṃcid viṣayī viṣayāntaram /
children.translated_text: then the experiencer does not apprehend any other object of sense;

children.text: śive viśrāmyate śaktistadā viśrāma ucyate // SomSv_27
children.translated_text: <s>Śakti</s> reposes in <s>Śiva</s> — then it is called 'repose' (<s>viśrāma</s>).
Where <s>Śakti</s> reposes, there the mind should dissolve;
then the self (<s>ātman</s>) should be known as [identical with] the Supreme Self (<s>Paramātman</s>) by those of firm understanding.

children.text: śivībhūto bhavatyātmā pariṇāmaḥ sa eva hi /
children.translated_text: The self becomes <s>Śiva</s>-ized — that itself is the 'transformation' (<s>pariṇāma</s>);

children.text: sadā sa varṣate divyam amṛtaṃ jantujīvanam // SomSv_29
children.translated_text: forever he rains down the divine <s>amṛta</s> (nectar) that gives life to beings.

children.text: cittaṃ tatra tu saṃdhārya punardaivī viśettu sā /
children.translated_text: Having steadied the mind there, that divine [<s>Śakti</s>] should enter again.

children.text: tadā tv āgamanaṃ proktamevaṃ samyak trayodaśa // SomSv_30
children.translated_text: Then the entry is declared — thus [are] the thirteen correctly [taught]. || <s>SomŚv</s> 30 ||
